description: The display for Genie, drawing its four double pendulums; it goes immediately to the right of the Genie it belongs to.

params.text: Sets how many past positions are drawn behind each weight, 1 to 100, each one fading as it ages, despite the maker's manual giving that to THICK.
Sets how often a new position is added to those trails, from one draw in five to every draw, despite the maker's manual giving that to SWARM.
Moves that pendulum left and right on the display; dragging its root weight with the mouse does the same.
Moves that pendulum up and down on the display; dragging its root weight with the mouse does the same.

inputs.text: The horizontal position of a shape drawn on the display in place of that pendulum; the Y jack of the same row has to be patched as well.
The vertical position of a shape drawn on the display in place of that pendulum; the X jack of the same row has to be patched as well.

notes: with a Genie immediately to the left the display draws that Genie's pendulums and the X and Y jacks are ignored.
with no Genie immediately to the left the display draws one shape from the X and Y jacks, and stays empty until the first X and Y jacks are both patched.
menu: Draw Lines between Nodes — joins the root and the weights of each pendulum with straight lines.
Color Root — sets the colour of the root, as red, green and blue sliders.
Color Node 1 — sets the colour of the first weight, as red, green and blue sliders.
Color Node 2 — sets the colour of the second weight, as red, green and blue sliders.
Color Node 3 — sets the colour of the third weight, as red, green and blue sliders.
Color Node 4 — sets the colour of the fourth weight, as red, green and blue sliders.
Color Lines — sets the colour of the lines joining the weights, as red, green and blue sliders.
